lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a multi-columnar 2D grid posterior to the branchial region. Distinct vertical columns containing 3 to 5 nodes each are visible between the lateral carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the centroid columns, forming a rectilinear lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity pixels on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadowed, lower intensity pixels on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs. A cluster of roughly 6-8 small spots is located in the anterior-basal quadrant, with scattered individual spots toward the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct V-shaped indentation or notch is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin exhibits a dense population of high-luminance, small-diameter spots compared to the lower density visible on the lower lobe.
